# Tree in Dev

> > A focused resource for Git and GitHub configuration guides, helping developers set up authentication and user credentials correctly.

Tree in Dev provides practical documentation on Git configuration and GitHub authentication workflows. The site covers essential setup tasks for developers working with version control systems.

## Key Topics

- Git
- GitHub
- Git Configuration
- User Credentials
- GitHub Authentication
- Access Tokens
- Git Setup
- GitHub User Access Token

## Git Configuration

- [How to Change Git User Name and Email](https://treeindev.net/article/git-change-user-name-email): Guide to configuring Git user name and email using git config command
